description: Test multiple reflected XSS vectors against a parameter. Sends 10 payloads (script tags, event handlers, SVG, attribute injection, case variation, template literals) and checks if they appear unescaped in the response. Returns results array with reflected/encoded/status per payload, and vulnerable_count. Side effects: Read-only GET requests. Sends 10 requests.

parameter.description: Parameter name that reflects input, e.g. 'q'

url.description: URL with reflectable parameter, e.g. https://target/search?q=test

name: xss_reflected_test
